AgentKind.description: What kind of agent a record is attributed to, a W3C PROV class.

oneOf.description: A program, such as a coding agent or a model.

Attribution.description:
`prov:wasAttributedTo`: who a record is attributed to, with the role the
agent had (`prov:hadRole`).

Change.description:
How far a revision moves a decision. Binding or retraining a model is
`minor`.

Metadata.description:
Who a resource is. Identity is `name`; grouping is by label, never by
where the document is stored.

annotations.description: Free notes; never used to select.

uid.description:
Identity that outlives the name: a UUID v4 assigned once, never derived
from the name (Kubernetes `metadata.uid`). Renaming a resource keeps it.

RevisionSpec.description:
The spec of the `Revision` record: a change to how a decision is judged,
approved by whoever it is attributed to. One that carries a `model` binds
that model to the decision before every other binding; one that carries
none unbinds it.

decision.description: The uid of the decision, else its name.

evaluation.description: The evaluation that justified it: metrics, labelled-set size and hash.

model.description:
The model it binds, `<provider>/<model>` (a learned one is
`local/learned@<artifact hash>`). A revision is a full snapshot: absent
means unbound, so a writer that does not change the model copies its
parent's.

parent.description: The id of the revision this one follows.

Role.description: The role a software agent had in a record, PROV's `hadRole`.

oneOf.description: A coding agent that reviewed the finding.
A model that classified the subject.
